# herdr-toolkit

> Claude Code plugin with one operating skill for running Claude Code on top of Herdr, the terminal agent multiplexer: phone-driven spawning of detached Remote Control sessions for any project directory (spawn-session).

Status: active; spawn-session is synced one way from the author's live Claude Code harness (`~/.claude`) by [scripts/sync-from-local.sh](scripts/sync-from-local.sh).

## Core documentation

- [Full AI Reference](llms-full.txt): self-contained facts, Q&A, and failure-mode catalog for this plugin
- [README](README.md): human-facing narrative (English)
- [README 日本語](README.ja.md): human-facing narrative (Japanese)
- [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md): release history (v2.0.0 removed the earlier herdr-delegate skill)

## Skills

- [spawn-session](skills/spawn-session/SKILL.md): spawn a named, detached Claude Code Remote Control session for any project directory; includes spawn.sh

## Plugin manifests

- [plugin.json](.claude-plugin/plugin.json): Claude Code plugin manifest (v2.0.0, MIT)
- [marketplace.json](.claude-plugin/marketplace.json): self-owned marketplace pointing at this repo

## Related

- [Herdr](https://github.com/ogulcancelik/herdr): the upstream terminal agent multiplexer (Apache-2.0, by ogulcancelik); installs its own herdr CLI skill, which spawn-session does not need
- [claude-harness](https://github.com/shimo4228/claude-harness): the author's aggregate harness export, where this skill also appears
- [akc-cycle](https://github.com/shimo4228/akc-cycle): the author's Claude Code plugin that installs the Agent Knowledge Cycle (audit and upkeep skills plus an optional rules file)
- [harness-scope](https://github.com/shimo4228/harness-scope): the author's Claude Code Mod that turns global skills, agents, rules and tools on or off per repo with named profiles
- [shimo4228](https://github.com/shimo4228/shimo4228): the author's hub, with the long-running practice lines and their DOIs
